# Nodding Flower Campion Seed Requirements

• **Temperature:** 15-20°C
• **Hydrometry:** 60-70%
• **Sunshine:** 4-6 hours
• **Rainfall:** 600-800mm
• **Humidity:** 65-75%
• **Soil Type:** Well-drained loam
• **Climate:** Temperate cool
• **Water Level:** Moderate moisture
• **Suitable Location:** Northern Europe
